paper_title: More Tokens, Lower Precision Towards the Optimal Token-Precision   Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
caption: The results of Layer-Wise Quantized Pruning on Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct, with SnapKV as pruning method. KV cache budget=1/64.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates layer-group–wise relative change (in percent) for several configurations of layer-wise quantized pruning, shown as multiple lines against a common zero baseline. The x-axis is categorical with five labeled groups—“Layer1-4,” “Layer5-12,” “Layer13-20,” “Layer21-28,” and “Layer29-32”—spaced evenly (no numeric units). The y-axis is labeled “Relative Change” on a linear scale in percent, ranging from about −25% at the bottom to +5% at the top, with visible tick labels at 5%, 0%, −5%, −15%, and −25%, and a gray dashed horizontal baseline at 0%. The “LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit” series is a light yellow solid line with circular markers, staying near 0% at Layer1-4 and Layer5-12, dipping to roughly −1.5% at Layer13-20, then returning to around 0% at Layer21-28 and slightly above 0% (about +0.3%) at Layer29-32. The “RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit” series is a light blue solid line with circular markers, around −1.5% at Layer1-4, about −2% at Layer5-12, dropping to roughly −13% at Layer13-20, then rising back to about −2% at Layer21-28 and approximately −1% to −1.5% at Layer29-32. The “LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit” series is a red solid line with square markers, near 0% at Layer1-4, about −1% at Layer5-12, reaching roughly −4.5% at Layer13-20, then moving upward to around −1.5% at Layer21-28 and about −0.5% near Layer29-32. The “RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit” series is a dark blue solid line with square markers, around −3% at Layer1-4, about −4% to −4.5% at Layer5-12, falling to approximately −25% at Layer13-20, then increasing to roughly −5.5% at Layer21-28 and about −3% to −3.5% at Layer29-32.
